# mobilityHubTools

<!-- badges: start -->
<!-- badges: end -->

The goal of mobilityHubTools is to provide software tools that might assist mobility hub implementers. This package was initially developed as part of research presented at [CERC 2026](https://github.com/James-Reynolds/WP5_mobilityHubTools_papers/blob/main/ReynoldsEtAl2026_CERC.pdf) in Galway, Ireland^[Reynolds, McCann, Armstrong Molsem, Stefaniec, Caulfield and Vega (2026) *Do-It-Yourself information provision with mobilityHubTools*], and through the Electric shaRed mOBility hUbs Trial (ROBUST) project.  

## Installation

You can install the development version of mobilityHubTools from [GitHub](https://github.com/) with:

``` r
# install.packages("pak")
pak::pak("James-Reynolds/mobilityHubTools")
```

## Example output

See inst/extdata/waterford_birmingham_test.pdf, ..._bristol_test.pdf and ..._synthesis_test.pdf for outputs generated for the ROBUST mobility hub in Waterford, Ireland (works in progress).
